newsitem.title: USA: WinsLoew sees 1996 EPS above estimates.
newsitem.headline: WinsLoew sees 1996 EPS above estimates.

text.p: WinsLoew Furniture Inc said Thursday 1996 earnings are expected to be higher than analysts' estimates.
It said earnings per share are seen in the $0.88 to $0.90 range.

After-tax income before restructuring charges and other adjustments was $2.6 million, or $0.40 per share, in 1995. After all adjustments, the company noted, it reported a loss of $4.0 million, or $0.45 per share.
WinsLoew said it expects to report 1996 results in late February. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
